context: A story-driven time series showing 30 months of actual revenue plus a 6-month forecast fan chart with 50/80/95% confidence bands, 3 event annotations, and a step-by-step narrative reveal triggered by button clicks.
first_impression: The screenshot captures the cold-start empty state before any story step is triggered, which looks blank but is intentional — the axes and grid are correctly scaled and the subtitle explains the interaction.
what_works: The step-sequenced narrative reveal is cognitively excellent: each button click introduces exactly one new element (line draw, event annotation, forecast bands), keeping working memory load minimal throughout. The three-color palette (blue for actual, cyan for forecast, purple for events) uses a restrained Tol muted scheme with clear semantic separation, and the three confidence bands are encoded with the same hue at decreasing opacities rather than separate colors — elegant and unambiguous.
what_doesnt: The 95% confidence band at 0.12 fill-opacity may be nearly invisible against the white background, making the outermost uncertainty bound the hardest to see at precisely the point where it matters most. The legend renders all six items (including forecast elements) before any story step is triggered, exposing the ending before the narrative begins — a minor but real spoiler that undercuts the sequenced reveal.
